gloss: a gift received; a present sent to one

definitions.gloss: a gift received; a present sent to one
definitions.explanation: A gift or present that has been sent or brought to someone. Often implies food gifts or seasonal gifts received from others.

examples.japanese: {到来物|とうらいもの}のお{菓子|かし}をみんなで{分|わ}けた。
examples.english: We shared the sweets that had been sent to us.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}になると{到来物|とうらいもの}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: At year-end, we receive more gifts.

examples.japanese: {到来物|とうらいもの}の{果物|くだもの}がとても{立派|りっぱ}だったので、{早速|さっそく}お{礼|れい}の{電話|でんわ}をした。
examples.english: The fruit we received as a gift was so impressive that I called to thank them right away.

notes:
USAGE:
A slightly formal or old-fashioned word. Common in the context of seasonal gift-giving (お{歳暮|せいぼ}, お{中元|ちゅうげん}) and neighborly exchanges. The word emphasizes the receiving side — something that has "arrived" ({到来|とうらい}) as a gift.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {到来物|とうらいもの}のお{裾分|すそわ}け (sharing a received gift with others)
- {到来物|とうらいもの}を{頂|いただ}く (to receive a gift — humble)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {贈|おく}り{物|もの}: gift — general term from the giver's perspective
- {頂|いただ}き{物|もの}: something received — humble/polite equivalent
